description: UE Experiment Console operator intent packet. This schema is documented for tooling; Scripts/UE5/smoke_ue_command_adapter.py implements the active smoke validation.
evidence_boundary: UE command packets express operator intent only.
MWORKS/ROS2 adapters must accept or reject the request before UE displays confirmed state.
UE commands must never overwrite UAV pose, teleport actors, or feed UE global truth to planners.

rules: require_mworks_ack must be true for all commands.
require_ros2_ack must be true when planner, perception, scene-switch, or shared MWORKS_ROS2 authority is touched.
reject_if_gate_open is a list of gate ids that make the adapter reject the command.

runtime_ack: Accepted state must be shown only after a mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 row from MWORKS, ROS2, or MWORKS_ROS2 authority.
